title: Robokidz Eduventures IPO Details
intro:
Robokidz Eduventures IPO is a book build issue of ₹31.09 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 29.33 lakh shares of ₹31.09 crore.

Robokidz Eduventures IPO opens for subscription on Sep 21, 2026 and closes on Sep 23, 2026. The allotment for the Robokidz Eduventures IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 24, 2026. Robokidz Eduventures IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 28, 2026.

Robokidz Eduventures IPO is set issue price band at ₹100 to ₹106 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,54,400 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,81,600.

GYR Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is B.N.Rathi Securities Ltd.

Refer to Robokidz Eduventures IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in December 2014, Robokidz Eduventures Limited is an education technology company engaged in providing technology-enabled learning and skill development solutions for K-12 students in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Coding, Electronics, and STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). The company offers end-to-end educational laboratory setup solutions, subscription-based learning programs, teacher training, digital learning platforms, educational kits, and technical support to schools, educational institutions, and government organizations across India.

The company operates through a diversified business model comprising Educational Laboratory Setup Projects, subscription-based Young Engineers Garage (YEG) programs, STEM workshops, boot camps, and franchise-based Young Engineers Academy (YEA) activity centres. Its proprietary digital platforms, coding solutions, and learning management systems support experiential, application-based learning aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, while its ISO-certified operations ensure high-quality educational delivery and technology integration.

Led by experienced promoter Sagar Lalit Sanghvi and a professional management team, the company focuses on expanding technology-driven education, strengthening its nationwide presence, and delivering innovative STEM learning solutions.
As of March 31, 2026, Robokidz Eduventures employed 24 professionals across technical, design & development, sales, operations, finance, legal, HR, and management functions.

about.text:
Incorporated in December 2014, Robokidz Eduventures Limited is an education technology company engaged in providing technology-enabled learning and skill development solutions for K-12 students in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Coding, Electronics, and STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). The company offers end-to-end educational laboratory setup solutions, subscription-based learning programs, teacher training, digital learning platforms, educational kits, and technical support to schools, educational institutions, and government organizations across India.

The company operates through a diversified business model comprising Educational Laboratory Setup Projects, subscription-based Young Engineers Garage (YEG) programs, STEM workshops, boot camps, and franchise-based Young Engineers Academy (YEA) activity centres. Its proprietary digital platforms, coding solutions, and learning management systems support experiential, application-based learning aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, while its ISO-certified operations ensure high-quality educational delivery and technology integration.

Led by experienced promoter Sagar Lalit Sanghvi and a professional management team, the company focuses on expanding technology-driven education, strengthening its nationwide presence, and delivering innovative STEM learning solutions.

As of March 31, 2026, Robokidz Eduventures employed 24 professionals across technical, design & development, sales, operations, finance, legal, HR, and management functions.

faqs.question: How to apply in Robokidz Eduventures IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Robokidz Eduventures IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Robokidz Eduventures IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Robokidz Eduventures IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Robokidz Eduventures IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Robokidz Eduventures IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Robokidz Eduventures IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Robokidz Eduventures IPO will be done on Thursday, September 24, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Sep 25, 2026 . Check the Robokidz Eduventures IPO allotment status .
